homograph.note: Verb /ɑːˈtɪkjuleɪt/ 'to put into clear words' and adjective /ɑːˈtɪkjələt/ 'good at expressing oneself' are spelled the same but pronounced differently in the final syllable; the meanings are related, so the split is one of pronunciation and part of speech, and a mnemonic must say which one it teaches.

senses.definition: to express an idea or a feeling clearly in words

examples.en: He struggled to articulate the fear that had kept him awake all night.
examples.fa: به‌سختی می‌توانست ترسی را که تمام شب بیدار نگهش داشته بود به زبان بیاورد.

senses.definition: able to express your thoughts clearly and easily in words

examples.en: She is an articulate speaker who never loses her audience.
examples.fa: او سخنوری شیواست که هرگز مخاطبش را از دست نمی‌دهد.
